### When You Can’t Pull Yourself Together
Author: Sarah Frazer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/when-you-cant-pull-yourself-together-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 61:2
Points:
- Life often brings burdens, grief, and exhaustion too massive to handle through human strength alone.
- When David felt overwhelmed, he turned immediately to God in honest and persistent prayer.
- The rock represents a high cliff that provides safety but cannot be climbed without God's help.
- Remembering God's past faithfulness anchors believers when facing overwhelming circumstances.
- Jesus does not demand that we fix everything ourselves, but invites us to rest in His care.

### Strong Tower
Author: Margaret D. Mitchell
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/a-womans-walk/strong-tower-god-s-love-at-work-week-of-march-2.html
Passage: Psalm 61:2-3
Points:
- When facing severe sickness and mortality, the Lord serves as an unshakeable shelter and strong tower.
- Leaning into God during life's hardest trials removes the sting and finality of death.
- Believers find true peace by running directly to the Rock rather than retreating in despair.
- Witnessing the enduring faith of a loved one emphasizes the urgency of sharing the gospel with others.
- Even in extreme suffering, maintaining faith in Christ leaves a lasting testimony of hope.
